description: Replacement of the existing detached bungalow with an enlarged three storey house comprising a two storey side and single storey rear projection and a single storey rear roof canopy.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed alteration and enlargement of the existing bungalow to form a replacement three storey house would be unacceptable as the proposal would result in the substantial external demolition of an existing bungalow within Chiswick House Conservation Area without the submission of a Heritage Statement assessing the existing building's historic context and significance, and outlining justifications for its loss not being harmful to the character and significance of the Conservation Area, and erection of a three storey house with a non-subservient sized two storey side projection and single storey rear roof canopy, incongruous fenestration design and poor quality, unsympathetic external materials, that would be harmful to the character, appearance and historic significance of the house and Chiswick House Conservation Area without contributing adequate counter balancing public benefits, contrary to Policies HE5 and HE6 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Plan Policies D4 and HC1 and Local Plan Policies SC7, CC1, CC2 and CC4 and the Character, Sustainability and Design Codes SPD: Residential Extension Guidelines.

Reason : 2 - The proposed alteration and enlargement of the existing bungalow which involves substantial demolition to form a replacement three storey house, as no Energy Statement was submitted as part of the application proposing measures to maximise the replacement house's energy efficiency and on-site clean energy generation without which this Council is unable to fully assess the application and without which the proposals cannot be considered to satisfy the requirements of the sustainable energy standards and climate change objectives of London Plan Policy SI2 and Local Plan Policy EQ1 for minor residential development.
